roadmapTask: Build the Assistant's MCP server: an MCP server the user's own Assistant connects to, exposing edit, validate, test-connection, run, Preview and read-logs tools for dev and Branch Environments only. Stage and prod requests are refused in the server's own code (ADR-0009), and tests assert that no MCP response contains a secret value. Settle first what the Assistant needs beyond those six tools, and how server code reliably tells a dev/Branch request from a stage/prod one.
